+    def _print_Derivative(self, expr):
+        dexpr = expr.expr
+        dvars = list(expr.variables)
+
+        # Group consecutive equal variables into (var, count) pairs, similar
+        # to how Mathematica's D function expects repeated differentiation
+        # with respect to the same variable to be written.
+        grouped = []
+        i = 0
+        n = len(dvars)
+        while i < n:
+            var = dvars[i]
+            count = 1
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < n and dvars[j] == var:
+                count += 1
+                j += 1
+            if count == 1:
+                grouped.append(var)
+            else:
+                grouped.append(Tuple(var, count))
+            i = j
+
+        return "Hold[D[" + ', '.join(self.doprint(a) for a in [dexpr] + grouped) + "]]"
+
